snippet.title: COMIC SHOP TYCOON - Coming Soon Trailer
snippet.description:
Comic Shop Tycoon is a first person shop management simulator where you order inventory, stock shelves, serve customers, set prices, and grow a small comic shop into a successful business filled with comics, collectibles, RPG books, dice, and more.

Comic Shop Tycoon is coming to Steam Early Access.

⭐ Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5119880/Comic_Shop_Tycoon/

Follow along for more gameplay, development updates, trailers, and a closer look at everything coming to Comic Shop Tycoon.

#ComicShopTycoon #IndieGame #SimulationGame #TycoonGame #GameDev #steam
